correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated 17 vertices, 68 graph edges, 68 triangles and zero tetrahedra. Rebuilt BFS parent and the 52 edge-triangle collapses, then reoriented all 340 Hasse cover edges and topologically sorted every one of 153 simplices: acyclic matching has 1 vertex, 16 2-cells, no 1-cells, proving wedge of sixteen S². Independently computed signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz character on all 136 affine maps: identity 16, 16 nonzero translations -1, remaining 119 maps 0. Midpoint map (u,v)→{u,v,(u+v)/2} is A-equivariant bijection of 68 edges and 68 triangles with the same signed edge stabilizer; chain cancellation in rational representation ring yields the vertex augmentation module. Character averaging and H∩T dichotomy establish all subgroup quotient ranks.
